reasons: Both answers explain the shared meaning and the neutral-vs-bookish split well, with natural B1 examples, in Russian. A at least links «едва ли» to «едва» ('barely'), while B never touches that, and neither covers «едва ли не». A also gives a direct style-choice exercise with paired sentences, which is more useful in class than B's situational prompts.

B: Overstates the meaning of «едва ли» as 'почти невозможно'; it expresses the same degree of doubt as «вряд ли».
